$comment: Benchmark v2 task briefs (DRAFT, not pre-registered). Hand-written; build-tasks.mjs turns them plus seed.json into tasks.json. Briefs describe a product need, not components, and use no library's component names. Interactions use accessible roles, names and visible text only.

tasks.title: SaaS app shell
tasks.brief: The signed-in shell of Lumen. Three screens share one layout: a dashboard at `/` (a welcome line and a few summary cards), a projects list at `/projects`, and a settings page at `/settings`. On desktop a left sidebar holds the navigation and can be collapsed to icons. The navigation has nested groups: an "Analytics" group containing "Overview" and "Reports", and a "Workspace" group containing "Projects" and "Settings". The current route is highlighted in the navigation. A header shows a breadcrumb for the current screen. On phones the sidebar is replaced by a menu button that opens the navigation in a drawer.
checklist: One shared layout (sidebar + header) on all three routes
Sidebar that can collapse to icons on desktop
Nested nav groups "Analytics" (Overview, Reports) and "Workspace" (Projects, Settings)
Active route highlighted in the navigation
Header breadcrumb matching the route
Phone: menu button opening the navigation as a drawer

interaction.describe: On a phone, opens the navigation drawer and expands the "Analytics" group.

tasks.title: Workspace switching
tasks.brief: Lumen's header lets people move between organisations and manage their account. Build a dashboard at `/` and a projects list at `/projects` inside a shared app layout. The header shows the current organisation ("Acme Labs") as a switcher: opening it lists the user's organisations with their plan, has a search field that filters them, marks the current one, and ends with a "Create organisation" action. The header also has a user menu, opened from the user's avatar, with their name and email, links to Profile and Settings, a light/dark theme choice, and Sign out. The current organisation's name also appears on the dashboard.
checklist: Shared layout on both routes
Organisation switcher showing "Acme Labs" as current
Switcher lists 3 orgs with plans, marks the current one, has a search field and "Create organisation"
User menu from the avatar: name, email, Profile, Settings, theme choice, Sign out
Current org name shown on the dashboard

interaction.describe: Opens the organisation switcher and types "north" into its search.

tasks.title: Command bar
tasks.brief: Lumen needs a command palette. Inside a shared app layout with three screens (a dashboard at `/`, projects at `/projects`, members at `/members`), pressing Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on a Mac) opens a palette with a search field. Results are grouped under "Pages" (the three screens), "Actions" ("Create project", "Invite member", "Toggle theme") and "Recent" (three recently opened projects). Typing filters every group; arrow keys move the highlight and Enter runs it. "Invite member" opens a dialog with an email field. A visible button in the header (with the shortcut shown next to it) opens the palette too, so it works on phones.
checklist: Shared layout on all three routes
Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a palette with a search field
Groups "Pages", "Actions" (Create project, Invite member, Toggle theme) and "Recent"
Typing filters; arrow keys move a visible highlight
"Invite member" opens a dialog with an email field
Header button with the shortcut hint opens the palette

interaction.describe: On desktop, presses Ctrl+K, types "inv" and presses the down arrow.

tasks.title: Analytics dashboard
tasks.brief: Lumen's analytics overview at `/` and a signups report at `/reports/signups`, in a shared layout. The overview has four KPI cards (visitors, signups, conversion rate, MRR), each with its change against the previous period, a line chart of daily visitors and signups, a bar chart of signups by channel, and a table of channels sortable by clicking its column headers. A date-range control ("Last 7 days", "Last 14 days", "Last 30 days") and a segment filter ("All users", "New users", "Returning users") sit above the charts, and changing either updates the KPIs and charts (derive the numbers from the data given). The signups report shows a larger signups chart and a daily table, with a link back to the overview.
checklist: Four KPI cards with change vs previous period
Line chart of daily visitors and signups
Bar chart of signups by channel
Channel table sortable by column header
Date-range control and segment filter that change KPIs and charts
Signups report route with a larger chart, a daily table and a link back

interaction.describe: Changes the date range to "Last 7 days".

tasks.title: Team and members
tasks.brief: Lumen's team page. At `/`, a members table shows each person's avatar or initials, name, email, role and status, with role and status as badges. A search field and a role filter narrow the table. Each row has an actions menu ("Change role", "Resend invite" for invited people, "Remove"). An "Invite member" button opens a dialog with a form: email (required, must be valid), role (required) and an optional message; submitting shows inline errors when the fields are invalid. Each member links to a detail page at `/members/[id]` showing their profile, role, status, join date and recent activity; `/members/m-02` is Daniel Reyes.
checklist: Members table with avatar or initials, name, email, role badge, status badge
Search field and role filter
Row actions menu (Change role, Resend invite, Remove)
"Invite member" dialog: email, role, optional message
Inline validation errors on submit
Member detail route with profile, role, status, join date and activity

interaction.describe: Opens the invite dialog and submits it empty.

tasks.title: Settings
tasks.brief: Lumen's workspace settings, one route per section: profile at `/settings/profile`, billing at `/settings/billing`, notifications at `/settings/notifications`, and a danger zone at `/settings/danger`, with a section navigation shared by all four (a side nav on desktop that becomes tabs or a menu on phones). Profile: name, email and avatar with inline validation and a Save button that is disabled until something changes. Billing: current plan (Team), seats used, next invoice date and amount, a payment method and an invoices table. Notifications: email and in-app toggles per event (mentions, assignments, weekly digest). Danger zone: transfer ownership, and "Delete workspace", which opens a confirmation dialog that asks the user to type the workspace name before the delete button is enabled. `/` redirects to `/settings/profile`.
checklist: Section navigation shared by all four routes (side nav on desktop, tabs or menu on phone)
Profile form with inline validation and a Save button disabled until changed
Billing: plan, seats, next invoice, payment method, invoices table
Notification toggles per event, for email and in-app
Danger zone: transfer ownership and "Delete workspace"
Delete confirmation dialog requiring the workspace name

interaction.describe: On the danger-zone page, opens the "Delete workspace" confirmation.

tasks.title: Issue tracker
tasks.brief: Lumen's issue tracker as a list-detail view. At `/` the list shows each issue's id, title, status, priority and assignee, with filters for status and assignee and an empty state when the filters match nothing. Selecting an issue opens it at `/issues/[id]`: on desktop the list stays on the left and the detail fills the right pane; on phones the detail replaces the list and has a back button. The detail shows the title, description, and selects for status and assignee that change the issue, plus an activity timeline. `/issues/LUM-104` is "Checkout fails on Safari 17".
checklist: Issue list with id, title, status, priority, assignee
Status and assignee filters, and an empty state
Desktop: list and detail side by side
Phone: detail replaces the list, with a back button
Detail: title, description, status and assignee selects, activity timeline

interaction.describe: Selects the issue "Checkout fails on Safari 17" and opens its status control.

tasks.title: Onboarding wizard
tasks.brief: Lumen's onboarding at `/`: a four-step wizard (1 Account: name and work email; 2 Workspace: workspace name and team size; 3 Invite: up to three teammate emails, skippable; 4 Preferences: theme and weekly digest). A step indicator shows where the user is. Back and Next move between steps; Next validates the current step and shows inline errors instead of moving on. A summary card beside the form (below it on phones) shows what has been entered so far. Finishing goes to `/welcome`, a done screen with a short checklist of next steps.
checklist: Step indicator for four steps
Per-step fields as described, with inline validation on Next
Back and Next buttons; Invite step skippable
Summary card beside the form on desktop, below it on phone
Welcome route with next steps

interaction.describe: Presses Next on step 1 with every field empty.

tasks.title: Rebrand: marketing site in a new identity
tasks.brief: Lumen has a new visual identity, and its marketing site must carry it through the design system's own theming, not one-off styles on each element. Apply the brand from the data: the brand colour for primary buttons, links and focus rings; a warm stone-grey neutral palette; a 4px corner radius on buttons, inputs, cards and menus; the serif heading font and the sans body font given (both are system fonts, so load nothing); and a dark theme by default with a light/dark toggle in the header that switches the whole site. Build the home page at `/` (a header with the logo text, navigation and the theme toggle; a hero with the tagline and two calls to action; a row of customer logos as text; three feature sections; a footer) and a pricing page at `/pricing` (a monthly/yearly switch that shows yearly prices at two months free, three plan cards with the Team plan highlighted, a feature comparison table, and the FAQ as an accordion), sharing the header and footer.
checklist: Brand colour on primary buttons and links
Warm grey neutrals; 4px radius on buttons, inputs, cards
Serif headings, sans body text
Dark by default; header toggle switches the whole site to light
Home: hero with two calls to action, logo row, three feature sections, footer
Pricing: monthly/yearly switch, three plans with Team highlighted, comparison table, FAQ accordion

tasks.title: Property listings with a map
tasks.brief: Haven, a home search site for Lisbon. At `/`, a search page: a filter bar (type, price range, minimum bedrooms, and a sort by newest, price or size), a results count, and the results as cards (photo placeholder drawn with CSS, price, title, beds, baths, area, district, a badge for homes listed in the last 7 days, and a save toggle) beside an interactive map. The map uses `maplibre-gl` (installed, as is `react-map-gl`) with the free map style URL in the data, centred on the given point: this style URL and its tiles are the only network resources the app may load. Every home shows on the map as a price marker; hovering a card highlights its marker and hovering a marker highlights its card; clicking a marker opens a small popup card. Filters update the list, the count and the markers together. On phones, the list and the map are two views with a toggle. At `/homes/h-104` (and every home's own `/homes/[id]`), a detail page: a gallery strip of CSS placeholders, price and key facts, the features, an energy rating, a small map with the home's location, and a contact form for the agent (name, email, message, all required, with inline errors) beside the facts on desktop.
checklist: Filter bar with type, price range, beds and sort; results count
Result cards with price, facts, new badge and save toggle
Interactive MapLibre map with price markers for every home
Card and marker hover highlight each other; marker click opens a popup
Filters update list, count and markers together; list/map toggle on phone
Detail route with gallery, facts, features, energy rating, mini map and validated agent contact form

interaction.describe: Hovers the card of the warehouse loft (h-104).

tasks.title: Video editor with a timeline
tasks.brief: Cutline, a browser video editor, editing the project in the data. At `/`, a full-window editor: a top bar with the project name, undo and redo, and an Export button; a media bin listing the media with type icons and durations; a preview area showing the frame at the playhead (draw it as the clip's colour with its title text and a timecode overlay; there is no real video) with play/pause, previous/next frame and a timecode readout; a multi-track timeline below with a time ruler, the four tracks (video, titles, music, voice-over) as labelled rows with mute and lock buttons, clips drawn at their start and length, a draggable playhead, and a zoom control that rescales the ruler and clips. Clicking a clip selects it and shows an inspector panel with its name, start, length, and either opacity and scale (video), text and font size (titles) or volume (audio), all editable and reflected in the timeline. Playing advances the playhead in real time. Export opens a dialog with the presets, an estimated size, and a progress bar once started. On narrow screens the media bin and inspector collapse into tabs or drawers so the preview and timeline stay usable.
checklist: Top bar with project name, undo/redo and Export
Media bin with type icons and durations
Preview with timecode, play/pause and frame stepping
Timeline with ruler, four labelled tracks with mute/lock, clips at the right positions, draggable playhead
Zoom control rescales the timeline
Selecting a clip opens an editable inspector matching the clip kind
Export dialog with presets, size estimate and progress
Narrow screens: bin and inspector collapse into tabs or drawers

interaction.describe: Clicks the 'Product close-up' clip on the timeline.

tasks.title: AI assistant workspace
tasks.brief: Orbit, an AI assistant workspace for a product team. A shared layout has a sidebar with a New chat button, a thread search, the threads grouped by when they were updated, and the user menu at the bottom; on phones it becomes a drawer. At `/`, a new-chat screen: a greeting, the suggestion chips, and the composer. At `/c/th-3`, the conversation from the data: user and assistant messages, the assistant's SQL rendered as a code block with a copy button, its result as a table, and actions under each assistant message (copy, retry, good/bad). The composer, at the bottom of both screens, is a growing text area with an attach button that adds file chips (removable), a model picker with the three models, and a send button that is disabled while empty; sending appends the user's message and a simulated streamed assistant reply with a stop button. At `/settings`, a settings page with the default model, a custom instructions text area, a theme choice, and data controls (export chats, delete all chats behind a confirmation dialog).
checklist: Sidebar with New chat, thread search, grouped threads and user menu; drawer on phone
New-chat screen with greeting and suggestion chips
Conversation with code block (copy button), result table and per-message actions
Composer: growing text area, attachments as removable chips, model picker, send disabled when empty
Sending shows a simulated streamed reply with a stop button
Settings: default model, custom instructions, theme, export and delete-all with confirmation
